title: Edit Metadata — Tier 2 (Partial)
description: Partial metadata for the Edit tool (file modification). Provenance is required. koth and decision are optional but recommended for significant edits. experiment and _compat not applicable.

notes.koth.outcome_signal: Set by PostToolUse. 'win' if edit applied successfully, 'loss' on error (e.g., old_string not found).
notes.koth.koth_domain: Domain of the file being edited.
notes.decision.signal_type: Typically 'post_decision' — Edit executes an already-made decision.
